title: Immutable preparer store revision
$comment: Runtime rejects duplicate decoded JSON keys, malformed UTF8, unknown envelope fields, unsafe/link paths and credential-bearing values. The recordHash is SHA256 of canonical sorted-key JSON for the envelope without recordHash. All revisions must form an unbroken previousHash chain; a separate checksummed high-water head must match its exact last revision/hash. Missing/corrupt/truncated state is never reset or replaced with an older eligible state. Head and record disagreement fail closed. The domain layer validates job/submission state machines; checksum is not a signature.
